about: A shop of mechanical curiosities designed by Tasmanian maker Shasa Bolton, featuring automata, puzzle boxes, magic tricks, robots, and other buildable contraptions.

automata.name: Automata
automata.description: Wooden automata kits — hand-cranked mechanical animals and birds, machines that write, draw, and animate. Inspired by classical clockwork automata. Learn about mechanisms, gears, cams, and levers as you assemble precision laser-cut parts and bring elegant motion to life.

magic-tricks.name: Magic Tricks
magic-tricks.description: Discover wooden magic tricks featuring clever hidden mechanisms, secret compartments, and ingenious mechanical designs. Available as beautifully finished pieces or DIY kits that let you build and explore the secrets behind the illusion. Designed for close-up and parlour magicians, as well as collectors of curious mechanical objects.

puzzle-boxes.name: Puzzle Boxes
puzzle-boxes.description: Wooden puzzle boxes featuring clever secret opening mechanisms. Solve the puzzle, discover the hidden mechanism, and unlock the box. Perfect for escape rooms, unique gifts, conversation pieces, and anyone who loves clever mechanical puzzles.

toys-and-games.name: Toys and Games
toys-and-games.description: Interactive and educational mechanical toys designed to inspire curiosity through making and exploration.

whirligigs.name: Whirligigs
whirligigs.description: Wind-powered whirligigs and kinetic garden ornaments — colourful characters that spin, bob and come alive in the breeze. Available as DIY kits or finished pieces.

blog.title: Blog
blog.description: Notes on design, builds, and behind-the-scenes from Contraption Cart.
